title: LuauNotes Personal Note
description: Schema for a personal note stored in my-notes/<id>.json. Personal notes are a separate layer on top of the canonical knowledge base — they never modify verified reference content.

id.description: Unique note id. Generated by the app on creation.

body.description: Note content. Supports markdown-lite: paragraphs, **bold**, `code`, - bullets, 1. lists, > quotes, ```lua code fences.

linkedEntries.description: IDs of knowledge entries this note is attached to (e.g. 'modulescript').

warnings.description: Personal warnings, rendered as alert cards.

importedFrom.description: Source file name when the note was imported.
